archive.catalogue_description: My first map made and completed so please don’t give me a hard time with it. I may add more to the map in the future but until then this is it. Features: No Dogs All Perks PAP Zombies don’t rise Modified weapons To add later (Possibly) Quizzes Impact-Nades Buyable Ending Special thanks to: Tom-Bmx (Mod Tools) Zomb1e K1ll3r (Tutorials) Jzob123 (helping with compiling, testing) and Everyone else at ZombieModding that helped sorry If I didn’t mention you if you helped.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
